summary: Davidson & Co has an established name and strong client testimonials. The site does not convert the visitors it already attracts, because its main enquiry buttons do not work.

findings.problem: The Enquire Now buttons in the header and hero, and the Subscribe Now button, link to # so they go nowhere. There is no enquiry form.
findings.cost: Every visitor who clicks Enquire Now and sees nothing happen is a lost client, and you never learn they tried.
findings.fix: A working enquiry form and consultation booking on every page.

findings.problem: The Our Awards and International Membership sections show logos with no names. Four testimonials are shown without case types, results or dates.
findings.cost: Unnamed awards and unspecific praise do not persuade a client choosing between firms.
findings.fix: Named awards, case type labelled testimonials and your LSRA licence number displayed.

findings.problem: Typos: Clink to call, relaible, enable instead of enables. The email link is webmaster@example.com and the header phone link has no country code.
findings.cost: A placeholder email loses messages and typos undercut a firm that sells accuracy.
findings.fix: A proofread build with correct, tested contact links.

findings.problem: The practices menu has 27 items and the hero text is long, pushing the call to action below the fold on a phone.
findings.cost: Most visitors decide in seconds on mobile. A long menu and a buried button send them away.
findings.fix: Grouped practice areas and a call to action visible without scrolling.

redesign: A conversion first homepage with a working enquiry form and booking above the fold.
Practice areas grouped into clear categories, with a page per service written to rank in search.
Proof where it counts: named partners, awards, labelled client results and licence details.
